L108@P4: beginning in late 2004, as the first step toward the expansion of the Dodge brand
L109@P4: outside of North America. The Viper SRT10 Roadster exhibits the bold, powerful
L110@P4: values of the Dodge brand just like its new sibling, the Viper SRT10 Coupe.
L111@P4: The Dodge Viper SRT10 Roadster is fitted with an 8.3-litre V-10 engine, heavy-duty
L112@P4: six-speed manual transmission and other high-performance treatments befitting an
L113@P4: SRT vehicle. A true convertible, the Viper SRT10 Roadster offers a bi-fold clamshell
L114@P4: top. This roof features a rigid cloth-covered front panel, glass rear window and a
L115@P4: single centre latch on the windscreen header.
L116@P4: The Dodge Viper SRT10 Coupe and Roadster are built at the Conner Avenue
L117@P4: Assembly Plant in Detroit, Michigan.
L118@P4: The Dodge brand goes global
L119@P4: Between 2003 and 2007, with the expansion of the Dodge brand, the Chrysler
L120@P4: Group will more than double the number of Chrysler Group models available outside
L121@P4: of North America. The number of right-hand drive and diesel-equipped models also
L122@P4: will more than double during this same time period.
L123@P4: While the Dodge Viper SRT10 Roadster teases the brand, in 2006 the Dodge
L124@P4: product portfolio for markets outside of North America will consist mainly of
L125@P4: C- and D-segment vehicles, both left- and right-hand drive, offering powerful
L126@P4: yet fuel-efficient petrol engines and state-of-the-art diesel engines.
L127@P4: The company plans to sell the portfolio of Dodge cars alongside Chrysler and Jeep®
L128@P4: products in most of the existing Chrysler Group dealer outlets. A new corporate
L129@P4: identity program for international Chrysler and Jeep dealers has been implemented
L130@P4: with the arrival of Dodge in mind. The program calls for the exterior and interior of
L131@P4: the showrooms to be designed with the flexibility to incorporate the third brand in a
L132@P4-5: cost-effective and modular way. DaimlerChrysler Communications, Stuttgart (Germany), Auburn Hills (USA)
L133@P5: Consumer research among 20,000 participants in Germany, France, Italy and the Press Information
L134@P5: UK identified a segment of potential buyers that align themselves with the core
L135@P5: values of Dodge. Research also showed that there is not a single brand that leads
L136@P5: this segment, creating opportunity for the Dodge brand to grow the Chrysler Group
L137@P5: business internationally, while maintaining its unique brand identity.
L138@P5: “We have a clear brand identity for Dodge. The brand is all about attitude — it’s
L139@P5: bold, confident and assertive,” said Joe Eberhardt, Executive Vice President
L140@P5: — Global Sales, Marketing and Service, Chrysler Group. “And we have established
L141@P5: a strong and distinct identity for our new Dodge products. That’s what allowed
L142@P5: us to tease international markets with the introduction of the Dodge Viper SRT10
L143@P5: Roadster last year and hint at where we can go in the years to come with concepts
L144@P5: such as the Dodge Caliber revealed here in Geneva.”
L145@P5: The international positioning for the brand and its future model lineup will be
L146@P5: entirely consistent with the established Dodge bold, confident and assertive values.
L147@P5: The expansion into markets outside of North America comes as Dodge celebrates
L148@P5: its 90-year heritage, placing the famous U.S. brand among the world’s most
L149@P5: successful long-standing automotive nameplates.
L150@P5: Dodge sold more than 1.4 million vehicles worldwide in 2004, which is half of the
L151@P5: Chrysler Group’s total sales. Dodge is the fifth-largest nameplate in the United
L152@P5: States, with a 6.9 percent market share
L153@P5: ON THE INTERNET
L154@P5: For more information on the Dodge brand expansion into markets outside of North
L155@P5: America, please visit http://www.media.discoverdodge.com.
L156@P5: Or visit DaimlerChrysler’s Media Services Web site at http://www.media.
L157@P5: daimlerchrysler.com for additional DaimlerChrysler news.

L108@P4: beginning in late 2004, as the first step toward the expansion of the Dodge brand
L109@P4: outside of North America. The Viper SRT10 Roadster exhibits the bold, powerful
L110@P4: values of the Dodge brand just like its new sibling, the Viper SRT10 Coupe.

L112@P4: six-speed manual transmission and other high-performance treatments befitting an
L113@P4: SRT vehicle. A true convertible, the Viper SRT10 Roadster offers a bi-fold clamshell

L115@P4: single centre latch on the windscreen header.
L116@P4: The Dodge Viper SRT10 Coupe and Roadster are built at the Conner Avenue
L117@P4: Assembly Plant in Detroit, Michigan.
L118@P4: The Dodge brand goes global
L119@P4: Between 2003 and 2007, with the expansion of the Dodge brand, the Chrysler
L120@P4: Group will more than double the number of Chrysler Group models available outside
L121@P4: of North America. The number of right-hand drive and diesel-equipped models also
L122@P4: will more than double during this same time period.

L124@P4: product portfolio for markets outside of North America will consist mainly of
L125@P4: C- and D-segment vehicles, both left- and right-hand drive, offering powerful
L126@P4: yet fuel-efficient petrol engines and state-of-the-art diesel engines.
L127@P4: The company plans to sell the portfolio of Dodge cars alongside Chrysler and Jeep®
L128@P4: products in most of the existing Chrysler Group dealer outlets. A new corporate
L129@P4: identity program for international Chrysler and Jeep dealers has been implemented
L130@P4: with the arrival of Dodge in mind. The program calls for the exterior and interior of
L131@P4: the showrooms to be designed with the flexibility to incorporate the third brand in a
L132@P4-5: cost-effective and modular way. DaimlerChrysler Communications, Stuttgart (Germany), Auburn Hills (USA)
L133@P5: Consumer research among 20,000 participants in Germany, France, Italy and the Press Information

A stock Ford Focus SVT has an open pickup cargo bed.

arguments.decision: How should the importer handle independently inconsistent fields within an otherwise useful secondary specification record?
arguments.evidence: The 30535-record compilation contains some internally inconsistent engine labels and impossible metric values, including a 62m car wheelbase. Other fields can have clear independent unit-bearing source strings. Manufacturer records cover only a subset. Source identity and per-field provenance are preserved. Unknown values can be explicitly estimated; measured values must not be invented.
arguments.priorities: User requires every eligible car/truck, real-spec research for every tunable field, labeled nearest-trim substitutions and documented estimates. Verified real dimensions take precedence.

candidates.description: Reject demonstrably invalid fields individually, retain independent supported fields and source raw values, and label fallback estimates with reasons.
Discard every record that contains any inconsistent field, including independently useful values.
Guess intended units and silently rewrite inconsistent fields to plausible values.

requirements: Does not present guessed corrections as measurements.
Retains enough provenance to audit each adopted field.

result.query: Which source directly documents the labeled 2005 Viper proxy's engine torque and gearbox with explicit physical units?
